headline: Bitcoin Slips to Four-Month Low at $62,000 as Crypto Selloff Broadens
summary: Bitcoin declined to $62,000, touching its lowest level in four months as selling pressure hit the broader cryptocurrency market. Second-largest token Ether has fallen 22% over the past week.
why: Bitcoin and Ether serve as benchmarks for liquidity and investor risk appetite across global digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Widespread crypto selling dragged Bitcoin prices down to four-month lows near $62,000.
